# Genghis Khan, Innovative Grill

> Grill restaurant in La Caleta (Costa Adeje, Tenerife, Canary Islands). Guests cook prime meats and fresh seafood themselves on a charcoal grill built into their table, in tables inspired by the time of Genghis Khan. Signature dish: Charcoal Grilled Lamb Shoulder, prepared in the Mongolian style. TripAdvisor Travellers' Choice Award 2025 (Best of the Best).

- Address: Centro Comercial San Sebastián, Calle la Enramada, Local 21, 38679 La Caleta, Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Spain
- Opening hours: Monday to Sunday, 13:30 – 23:00
- Phone: +34 922 692 798 · +34 688 151 137
- WhatsApp: +34 694 462 568
- Email: bookings@genghiskhangrilltenerife.com
- Bookings: online through the reservation widget on the Bookings page, by phone or by email. Larger groups and events: contact bookings@genghiskhangrilltenerife.com.
- Menu languages: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Dutch. Prices exclude IGIC (Canary Islands tax).
- Allergens: allergen information for every dish is available on request (EU Regulation 1169/2011).

## Pages

- [Home](https://genghiskhangrilltenerife.com/): Overview of the restaurant, the tabletop grill experience, award, guest reviews and Instagram.
- [Menu](https://genghiskhangrilltenerife.com/menu/): Full menu with prices in six languages. Categories: Soups, Cold Starters, Hot Starters, Salads, Fire & Flavour, Chicken, Skewers, Lamb, Pork, T-Bone, Beef, Seafood Specialties, Side Dishes, Exquisite Sauces, Kids' Menu.
- [Bookings](https://genghiskhangrilltenerife.com/bookings/): Reserve a table online.
- [Lamb Shoulder](https://genghiskhangrilltenerife.com/lamb-shoulder/): The signature Charcoal Grilled Lamb Shoulder, from New Zealand lamb, marinated in a house blend of herbs and spices.
- [About](https://genghiskhangrilltenerife.com/about/): The story of cooking with fire and charcoal that inspires the restaurant.
- [Awards](https://genghiskhangrilltenerife.com/awards/): TripAdvisor Travellers' Choice Award 2025.
- [Contact](https://genghiskhangrilltenerife.com/contact/): Address, map, phones, email and frequently asked questions.
